answer.evidence: radon/complexity.py:10-12 define the sort keys: SCORE = lambda block: -GET_COMPLEXITY(block) (descending complexity), LINES = block.lineno, ALPHA = block.name. radon/complexity.py:59-75 sorted_results(blocks, order=SCORE) returns sorted(blocks, key=order). Review points: ALPHA is case-sensitive, so uppercase names sort before lowercase. SCORE and LINES have no tie-breaker beyond Python's stable sort. The docstring typo "sorty" at line 71 should be fixed. The CLI at radon/cli/__init__.py:160 resolves the key with getattr(cc_mod, order.upper(), SCORE), which silently falls back to SCORE on an unknown value. The key functions depend on block attributes (lineno, name, complexity) that radon/visitors.py provides on Function and Class objects, so check that those attributes are consistently present. radon/raw.py and radon/metrics.py are not involved in this ordering. radon/cli/harvest.py:356 has a separate sort by 'mi'.
